description: At time \(t+1\), the bounded run of machine \(M\) keeps the current configuration if it has halted and otherwise applies its transition.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.MachinesAndComputationHistories.run_succ
  (M : Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.MachinesAndComputationHistories.Machine) (x t : ℕ) :
  Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.MachinesAndComputationHistories.run M x (t + 1) =
    if M.halt (Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.MachinesAndComputationHistories.run M x t) = true then
      Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.MachinesAndComputationHistories.run M x t
    else M.transition (Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.MachinesAndComputationHistories.run M x t)
